items.title: Switch — SoundCloud + YouTube upload package

items.title: Switch — SoundCloud + YouTube upload package (SUPERSEDES ap-2026-06-19-switch-upload: target date corrected to 2026-07-25)
items.summary: Same package as ap-2026-06-19-switch-upload (metadata, description, checklist, captions, art-prompt — unchanged, no content edits). The only difference is the date this approval targets: ap-2026-06-19-switch-upload's summary still says 'scheduled to go public on 2026-07-18.' That date is no longer the team's plan. Ten consecutive silent days (Jun 18-27) on the two required inputs (beat store URL, July 18 publish time) crossed the calendar's own pre-announced June 27 hard line — see team/reports/q3-2026-release-calendar.md, Switch section, dated 2026-06-27. Switch's target moved to 2026-07-25 by default today. This entry exists because the README's approvals contract only lets agents append pending items, not edit existing ones — approving the original entry as literally worded would direct a July 18 schedule that contradicts the current plan, a real risk, not a cosmetic one (distinct from the W26 X-post queue-summary case on 06-24/06-25, where both possible framings degraded to the same action). Recommend: if you approve a Switch upload, approve THIS entry (07-25) and reject ap-2026-06-19-switch-upload as stale; or simply note your intended date when you act and either is fine procedurally — only the date framing differs, not the underlying package. The two required inputs (beat store URL, publish time) are still [TBD] in the linked drafts regardless of which entry is actioned.

items.title: Confirmation check — 10k.emraan collab credit on Switch
items.summary: Approving this queues a short outreach message asking 10k.emraan to confirm the co-producer credit on Switch (billing/split/name-as-it-should-appear) before the July 25 release. This is NOT a reply to any inbound message — I checked my own lane (team/reports/contacts.md does not exist as a file, team/inbox/ has no records, cursors.json is fully empty across discord/imap/copyparty) and found zero record anywhere in booking/outreach history of contact with '10k.emraan.' The name appears only in content/copy/metadata (arc doc, captions, catalog artist field, this queue's own ap-2026-06-19 and ap-2026-06-17 summaries) — never in a message, reply, or logged correspondence. I have no contact address/handle on file for this person, so this draft cannot actually be sent as-is; it needs ISΛRK to either supply a channel or confirm the agreement already happened off-record (DM, call, in-person) so we can just log it instead. Recommend resolving this before the W25/W28 collab-story posts and the gap-reshare copy go out, since content built on an unconfirmed premise compounds the longer it runs unaddressed.

items.title: Switch gap-bridge touchpoint 2 — collab-story post, Variant B (standalone framing)
items.summary: Approving this posts the gap-bridge touchpoint 2 piece from team/drafts/content/switch-w28-gap-reshare-copy.md as a single standalone X post, exactly as pre-drafted: 'two producers. one 186 bpm idea. ISΛRK × 10k.emraan — Switch, july 25.' Variant B applies, not Variant A, because ap-2026-06-17-switch-w25-collab-story (the original W25 collab-story post this would otherwise reshare/quote) is still pending/unpublished as of this run — verified directly against its status field before drafting this entry. Per Variant B's own instruction, no 'still true' callback line is used since there is no prior published post for it to refer back to; this is the collab-story line's first real posting, timed late in the arc (~July 23-24, two days ahead of the July 25 release) as a pre-drop closer rather than a W25 opener. No link, no hashtags, no beat store URL, no publish-time claim anywhere in the copy — both remain [TBD] in checklist.md and description.md, re-verified fresh today (2026-07-23), and are not being fabricated to force a countdown element into this post (path 2 of the three-path decision plan Hemera recorded 2026-07-22, not path 1). This is reshare-only per Hemera's 2026-07-23 standup decision: she judged the open 10k.emraan credit-confirmation question (ap-2026-07-06-collab-confirm-10k-emraan) does not block this specific post, since the identical collab claim is already live and unblocked elsewhere in the pipeline (the queued W25 post itself, and the catalog artist field). This entry does not supersede or resolve ap-2026-06-17-switch-w25-collab-story — that item stays pending independently; if it is later approved and published, this post has already run as the de facto first posting, and Variant A's reshare framing described in switch-w28-gap-reshare-copy.md would no longer apply retroactively.
